meta.name: azure-diagnostics
meta.description: Debug Azure production issues on Azure using AppLens, Azure Monitor, resource health, and safe triage. WHEN: debug production issues, troubleshoot app service, app service high CPU, app service deployment failure, troubleshoot container apps, troubleshoot functions, troubleshoot AKS, VM RDP, Linux SSH, VM black screen, can't connect to VM, reset VM password, NSG or firewall blocking, kubectl cannot connect, kube-system/CoreDNS failures, pod pending, crashloop, node not ready, upgrade failures, analyze logs, KQL, insights, image pull failures, cold start issues, health probe failures, resource health, root cause of errors, troubleshoot event hubs, troubleshoot service bus, messaging SDK error, AMQP connection failure, message lock lost, service bus dead letter.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排解 Azure 线上故障,定位根因并恢复服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 云环境,遇到生产故障需要快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Debug Azure production issues, find root causes, and restore services
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Azure environments and need to quickly diagnose incidents

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用系统化流程排查 Azure 生产故障:先判断症状、检查资源健康,再查日志和指标,并借助 AppLens、Azure Monitor 等工具定位根因和给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要排查 Azure 生产问题,比如提到“troubleshoot app service”“app service high CPU”,或说 VM 连不上、AKS 故障、消息服务报错等时触发。

say.text: 帮我排查 App Service 高 CPU 的根因
say.note: 会先查资源健康再查日志和指标

say.text: 我的 VM 连不上,RDP 超时,帮我诊断
say.note: 会引导检查 NSG、防火墙和凭据重置

say.text: 查一下 Service Bus 消息丢失的原因
say.note: 会按消息服务手册排查 AMQP 和锁丢失

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a structured workflow to debug Azure production issues: identify symptoms, check resource health, review logs and metrics, then use AppLens, Azure Monitor, and Resource Health to find root causes and suggest fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to debug or troubleshoot Azure production issues—e.g., App Service high CPU, VM connectivity failures, AKS problems, or messaging errors—or when you mention relevant symptoms.

say_en.text: Help me find the root cause of high CPU on App Service
say_en.note: Checks resource health first, then logs and metrics.

say_en.text: My VM is unreachable and RDP times out—diagnose it
say_en.note: Guides through NSG, firewall, and credential checks.

say_en.text: Investigate why Service Bus messages are being lost
say_en.note: Follows messaging troubleshooting for AMQP and lock issues.
